name: What does flattening a PDF actually do?

acceptedAnswer.text: Flattening merges all interactive layers — form fields, annotations, digital signatures, and overlays — into the static page content. The result is a flat, non-interactive PDF that looks identical to the original but cannot be edited.

name: Does PDFree store or log my files after processing?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. PDFree runs entirely in your browser — there is no backend server that receives your files. Because nothing is uploaded, nothing can be stored, logged, or retained. Your document exists only in your browser's memory for the duration of the session and is cleared when you close the tab.

name: Can I reverse a flattened PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Flattening is irreversible — the original form fields are permanently replaced by static visual content. Always keep a backup of your original filled PDF before flattening if you think you might need to change values later.

Drawn signatures created with the Fill PDF tool (signature pad images) are flattened into the page. Cryptographic digital signatures from certified e-signature providers may be handled differently — the visual appearance is preserved but the cryptographic certificate may no longer validate after flattening.

name: Is my PDF uploaded to any server?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Everything runs in your browser using pdf-lib. Neither your original PDF nor the flattened result is ever sent anywhere. Your document and its contents stay on your device at all times.

name: Why flatten instead of just saving the filled PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: A saved filled PDF still contains editable fields — a recipient could clear your values and re-fill them. Flattening permanently locks the content into the page, prevents editing, ensures consistent rendering across all PDF viewers, and removes hidden form metadata from the file.

name: How do I flatten a PDF in my browser?

acceptedAnswer.text: PDFree Flatten runs in any modern browser — Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge — on Mac, Windows, and Linux. No download or installation is required. Open the Flatten PDF tool, load your PDF, click Flatten, and the result downloads directly to your device. No desktop software needed at any step.

name: Does flattening a PDF reduce file size?

acceptedAnswer.text: Often slightly. Flattening removes interactive form widget data and JavaScript, which reduces file size for forms with many fields. However, images and embedded fonts are unaffected by flattening. For significant size reduction, run the flattened output through a PDF compressor after flattening.

name: What is the difference between flattening and password-protecting a PDF?

acceptedAnswer.text: They solve different problems. Flattening removes the interactive form structure entirely — no fields exist to edit, regardless of permissions. Password protection restricts access or editing rights but leaves form fields intact; someone with the password could still modify a fillable form. For maximum security, flatten first to lock the content, then add a password.

name: Can I flatten multiple PDF files at once?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. PDFree's batch mode flattens form fields and annotations across as many PDF files as you select, processing each one locally in your browser. Download all the flattened files together as a ZIP — no size cap, no signup required.
